Shelby County Board of Commissioners
Resolution 2025-RC-0047

WHEREAS, QTS Realty Trust has proposed a 200 MW hyperscale data center campus on approximately 450 acres along the I-75 corridor in Jackson Township; and

WHEREAS, the Board finds the project consistent with Shelby County's economic development priorities and the county's industrial land-use framework;

NOW THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that the Board approves a Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) agreement with QTS Realty Trust for a term of 15 years, contingent on AEP Ohio executing a Large Load Service Agreement and the Ohio EPA issuing an Air PTI for the facility's emergency generators.

Adopted: March 12, 2025
Vote: 3-0
